config.outputType:
z.object({
  ourFeatures: z.array(z.any()),
  competitors: z.array(z.any()),
  featureCount: z.number(),
  competitorCount: z.number(),
  featuresJson: z.string()
})

config.systemPrompt:
You are a product owner enriching a feature backlog with competitive intelligence.

You will receive:
1) Our full feature list (static context)
2) One competitor profile

For EVERY existing feature, explain how this competitor addresses the same capability, where we differ, and what we should emphasize. Keep descriptions non-technical.

Also identify net-new features this competitor has that we do not. Mark those with isNew: true.

Rules:
- Preserve existing logicalId, keyword, and category for existing features.
- For existing features, keep the original description but you may lightly refine it if competitor insight improves clarity.
- competitiveNotes: 1 short paragraph on what the competitor does for this capability.
- differentiation: 1 short paragraph on how we should position differently.
- For net-new features, propose keyword and category slugs.
- Include the competitor logicalId in competitorLogicalId on every row.
config.userPrompt:
## Our product features ({{collect_context.result.featureCount}} features)

```json
{{collect_context.result.featuresJson}}
```

## Competitor to analyze

```json
{{prepare_competitor.result.competitorJson}}
```

Analyze this competitor against ALL of our features above.

Return:
- competitorLogicalId and competitorName
- features: every existing feature enriched for this competitor, plus any net-new features inspired by this competitor (isNew: true)

Use the exact logicalId from our features for existing items. For net-new features, omit logicalId.
config.outputType:
z.object({
  competitorLogicalId: z.string(),
  competitorName: z.string(),
  features: z.array(z.object({
    logicalId: z.string().optional(),
    title: z.string(),
    description: z.string(),
    keyword: z.string(),
    category: z.string(),
    sourceArtifacts: z.array(z.string()),
    competitiveNotes: z.string(),
    differentiation: z.string(),
    isNew: z.boolean()
  }))
})

z.array(z.object({
